title: Review verdict of lernapps, version 1
description: What the review agent judged on an app that asks to be listed, as YAML (verdict.yaml): the reviewed commit, the rules judged, and every finding with its rule id or a proposed new rule. Written by the agent that follows review/prompt.md of @lernapps/tooling, checked with `npm run verdict -- <file>`. A breaking change gets a new version of this schema.

reviewed.description: What was reviewed: the commit of the app's repo, and where the app and its listing are.

commit.description: The full id of the reviewed commit

repo.description: The app's repo: a URL, or a directory

url.description: Where the app is deployed, if it was reviewed there

listing.description: The listing pull request, if there is one

report.description: The validation report of `lernapps check` the review started from: its file, or the URL of the listing comment that holds it.

archetype.description: The archetype from the plan's front matter; null when the app has no plan file. It selects review/archetypes/<archetype>.md.

outcome.description: fail when a finding has severity error, else pass. The owner decides on the listing.

rules.description: The ids of the rubric items judged: those of review/rubric.md and of the archetype's file.

findings.description: Every finding, sorted by severity and rule id. Each names a rule of the catalog (rule, link), or proposes a new rule (proposal).

rule.description: The id of the broken rule, as `npm run rules` lists it

link.description: The rule's entry on the rule page

proposal.description: A new rule, when no rule of the catalog covers the finding.

id.description: A stable name that is no rule id yet

text.description: The rule, as a skill would tell it

where.description: File of the bundle or repo and element, page, or the plan's section

moveTo.description: For a rule of the catalog: where it could be decided or prevented next time, so that it moves down from the review
